summary.name: MacPacker
summary.one_liner: MacPacker is a free, open-source macOS archive browser that lets you preview archive contents, open nested archives, and extract only the files you need.
use_cases: Previewing files inside an archive without extracting it
Pulling out a single file from a large archive
Creating or editing ZIP files on a Mac
Opening RAR, 7z, TAR, DMG or ISO files
summary.what_it_does: MacPacker opens archives and disk images in a Finder-like window so you can browse their contents before extracting anything. It supports previewing files with Quick Look, stepping into nested archives, and dragging out individual files. The page says it opens 41 archive and disk-image formats, including ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR variants, DMG, ISO and CAB. As of version 0.18 it can also create new ZIP archives, add or delete files in existing ZIPs, and compress items to ZIP from Finder.
notable: Browse and preview archive contents without extracting the whole archive
Open-source under GPL-3.0 with source code on GitHub
Native Apple Silicon app built with Swift and SwiftUI
Creates and edits ZIP archives as of version 0.18
caveats: Archive creation and editing is limited to ZIP; other formats are still in development
Keka covers more formats for compression, according to the page
